title: SEA-Guard: Culturally Grounded Multilingual Safeguard for Southeast Asia
benchmark_measurement: Detection of harmful, stereotypical, or culturally insensitive content related to religious topics, such as generalizations about religious groups (e.g., assuming all Indonesians are Muslim) and religious food prohibitions.
findings: Existing safeguard models perform poorly on culturally and religiously sensitive topics specific to Southeast Asia, failing to block prompts that make harmful generalizations (e.g., assuming all Indonesians are Muslim). The proposed SEA-Guard model, trained on culturally grounded data including religious contexts, significantly outperforms these existing models in identifying regionally sensitive content while maintaining strong general safety performance.
